args.title: Find all references to useUiePage in the repository
args.description: Search the entire repository for all usages of the useUiePage function/hook. Use file_search or grep to locate all references, then read the relevant files to understand the purpose of each usage. Provide a summary listing each location and its purpose.
success_criteria: A comprehensive list of all useUiePage references with their file locations
Explanation of the purpose of each usage

args.title: Translate English comments in ensureProductionUie to Chinese
args.description: Open apps/desktop/src/lib/uiEngine.ts, locate the ensureProductionUie function, find all English comments, and translate them to Chinese. Preserve the code logic, only modify comments.
success_criteria: All English comments in ensureProductionUie are translated to Chinese

args.title: Write usage documentation for new showPage feature
args.description: Create a new markdown file docs/uie-show-page.md with comprehensive usage documentation for the new showPage feature in TinadecUI. Include examples, parameters, and common use cases. First read relevant source files to understand the feature, then write the documentation.
success_criteria: Documentation includes feature description, parameters, and usage examples

args.title: Review uncommitted changes for potential risks
args.description: Examine all uncommitted changes in the current workspace using git diff. Analyze the changes for potential risks including: breaking changes, security issues, missing error handling, performance problems, or architectural violations. Provide a detailed risk assessment report.
success_criteria: Complete review of all uncommitted changes
Risk assessment with specific findings listed

args.title: Commit changes and push to remote main branch
args.description: Commit all current changes with an appropriate commit message describing the UIE refactoring work, then push the commit to the remote main branch.
success_criteria: Commit is pushed to remote main branch
git status shows no uncommitted changes

args.title: Fetch and summarize Vue.js Vapor mode limitations
args.description: Fetch the content from https://vuejs.org/guide/extras/vapor.html and read the documentation about Vue Vapor mode. Summarize the key limitations and constraints of Vapor mode in a clear, structured format.
success_criteria: Content successfully fetched from the URL
Summary of Vapor mode limitations provided

args.title: Run desktop unit tests and fix failures
args.description: Execute the desktop unit test suite, identify any failing tests, debug the failures, and implement fixes to make all tests pass. Update test files and source files as needed.
success_criteria: All test failures identified and logged

args.title: Show what the last 5 commits changed
args.description: Use git log to retrieve information about the last 5 commits. For each commit, show the commit hash, author, date, message, and the files that were changed in that commit.
success_criteria: For each commit: hash, message, and changed files listed

args.title: Count remaining !important declarations in styles.css
args.description: Read apps/desktop/src/styles.css and count how many times !important appears in the file. Report the total count.

args.title: Update port number in README.md
args.description: Read README.md, find all instances of port number 48730, and replace them with 48740. Write the updated file back.

args.title: Complete missing i18n keys and commit
args.description: Search for missing i18n keys in the codebase, identify which translation keys are referenced but not defined, add the missing keys to the i18n configuration files, then commit this change with an appropriate message.
success_criteria: Missing keys added to i18n files

args.title: Perform security review of branch diff vs main
args.description: Compare the current branch against main branch using git diff. Conduct a comprehensive security review checking for: hardcoded secrets, SQL injection vulnerabilities, authentication/authorization issues, data exposure, insecure dependencies, missing input validation. Provide a detailed security assessment report.
success_criteria: Git diff between current branch and main obtained

args.title: Update CHANGELOG.md with UIE refactoring notes
args.description: Read CHANGELOG.md and add a new entry documenting the UIE (TinadecUI Engine) refactoring work. Include description of major changes, improvements, and any breaking changes. Write the updated file.
success_criteria: New entry added documenting UIE refactoring
Entry follows existing CHANGELOG format and conventions
